dialogue_texts: Hah! I suppose a queen doesn't need much purification after all. You certainly haven't lost your edge.
Your training was a noisy distraction. I have yet to see a single person affected by the glohm.
Well, you're looking in the wrong place.
If you want trouble, head towards the Amber Woods. The air is starting to rot over there.
I shall inspect these woods and see what gaps have been left open.
